verses.original: Ἀδελφοί ἡ μὲν εὐδοκία τῆς ἐμῆς καρδίας καὶ ἡ δέησις πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν εἰς σωτηρίαν
verses.transliteration: Adelphoi hē men eudokia tēs emēs kardias kai hē deēsis pros ton Theon hyper autōn eis sōtērian
verses.literal: Brothers my heart’s desire and prayer to God for the Israelites is for their salvation
verses.literalPt: IRMÃOS, o bom desejo do meu coração e a oração a Deus por Israel é para sua salvação.

verses.original: μαρτυρῶ γὰρ αὐτοῖς ὅτι ζῆλον Θεοῦ ἔχουσιν ἀλλ’ οὐ κατ’ ἐπίγνωσιν
verses.transliteration: martyrō gar autois hoti zēlon Theou echousin all’ ou kat’ epignōsin
verses.literal: For I testify about them that they are zealous for God but not on the basis of knowledge
verses.literalPt: Porque lhes dou testemunho de que têm zelo de Deus, mas não com entendimento.

verses.original: ἀγνοοῦντες γὰρ τὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ δικαιοσύνην καὶ τὴν ἰδίαν δικαιοσύνην ζητοῦντες στῆσαι τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐχ ὑπετάγησαν
verses.transliteration: agnoountes gar tēn tou Theou dikaiosynēn kai tēn idian dikaiosynēn zētountes stēsai tē dikaiosynē tou Theou ouch hypetagēsan
verses.literal: Because they were ignorant - of God’s righteousness and sought to establish their own they did not submit to God’s righteousness
verses.literalPt: Porquanto, não conhecendo a justiça de Deus, e procurando estabelecer a sua própria justiça, não se sujeitaram à justiça de Deus.

verses.original: τέλος γὰρ νόμου Χριστὸς εἰς δικαιοσύνην παντὶ τῷ πιστεύοντι
verses.transliteration: telos gar nomou Christos eis dikaiosynēn panti tō pisteuonti
verses.literal: For Christ is the end of the law to bring righteousness to everyone who believes
verses.literalPt: Porque o fim da lei é Cristo para justiça de todo aquele que crê.

verses.original: Μωϋσῆς γὰρ γράφει ὅτι τὴν δικαιοσύνην τὴν ἐκ τοῦ νόμου ὅτι Ὁ ποιήσας αὐτὰ ἄνθρωπος ζήσεται ἐν αὐτῇ
verses.transliteration: Mōusēs gar graphei hoti tēn dikaiosynēn tēn ek tou nomou hoti Ho poiēsas auta anthrōpos zēsetai en autē
verses.literal: For concerning the righteousness that is by the law Moses writes The man who does these things will live by them
verses.literalPt: Ora Moisés descreve a justiça que é pela lei, dizendo: O homem que fizer estas coisas viverá por elas.

verses.original: ἡ δὲ ἐκ πίστεως δικαιοσύνη οὕτως λέγει Μὴ εἴπῃς ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου Τίς ἀναβήσεται εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν τοῦτ’ ἔστιν Χριστὸν καταγαγεῖν
verses.transliteration: hē de ek pisteōs dikaiosynē houtōs legei Mē eipēs en tē kardia sou Tis anabēsetai eis ton ouranon tout’ estin Christon katagagein
verses.literal: But the righteousness that is by faith says Do not say in your heart Who will ascend into heaven (that is to bring Christ down . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas a justiça que é pela fé diz assim: Não digas em teu coração: Quem subirá ao céu? (isto é, a trazer do alto a Cristo.)

verses.original: ἤ Τίς καταβήσεται εἰς τὴν ἄβυσσον τοῦτ’ ἔστιν Χριστὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀναγαγεῖν
verses.transliteration: ē Tis katabēsetai eis tēn abysson tout’ estin Christon ek nekrōn anagagein
verses.literal: or Who will descend into the Abyss (that is to bring Christ up from the dead
verses.literalPt: Ou: Quem descerá ao abismo? (isto é, a tornar a trazer dentre os mortos a Cristo.)

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ τί λέγει Ἐγγύς σου τὸ ῥῆμά ἐστιν ἐν τῷ στόματί σου καὶ ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου τοῦτ’ ἔστιν τὸ ῥῆμα τῆς πίστεως ὃ κηρύσσομεν
verses.transliteration: Alla ti legei Engys sou to rhēma estin en tō stomati sou kai en tē kardia sou tout’ estin to rhēma tēs pisteōs ho kēryssomen
verses.literal: But what does it say The word is near you it is in your mouth and in your heart that is the word of faith we are proclaiming
verses.literalPt: Mas que diz? A palavra está junto de ti, na tua boca e no teu coração; esta é a palavra da fé, que pregamos,

verses.original: ὅτι ἐὰν ὁμολογήσῃς ἐν τῷ στόματί σου Κύριον Ἰησοῦν καὶ πιστεύσῃς ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς αὐτὸν ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν σωθήσῃ
verses.transliteration: hoti ean homologēsēs en tō stomati sou Kyrion Iēsoun kai pisteusēs en tē kardia sou hoti ho Theos auton ēgeiren ek nekrōn sōthēsē
verses.literal: that if you confess with your mouth Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead you will be saved
verses.literalPt: A saber: Se com a tua boca confessares ao Senhor Jesus, e em teu coração creres que Deus o ressuscitou dentre os mortos, serás salvo.

verses.original: καρδίᾳ γὰρ πιστεύεται εἰς δικαιοσύνην στόματι δὲ ὁμολογεῖται εἰς σωτηρίαν
verses.transliteration: kardia gar pisteuetai eis dikaiosynēn stomati de homologeitai eis sōtērian
verses.literal: For with your heart you believe and are justified and with your mouth you confess and are saved
verses.literalPt: Visto que com o coração se crê para a justiça, e com a boca se faz confissão para a salvação.

verses.original: Λέγει γὰρ ἡ γραφή Πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων ἐπ’ αὐτῷ οὐ καταισχυνθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Legei gar hē graphē Pas ho pisteuōn ep’ autō ou kataischynthēsetai
verses.literal: It is just as the Scripture says Anyone who believes in Him will never be put to shame
verses.literalPt: Porque a Escritura diz: Todo aquele que nele crer não será confundido.

verses.original: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν διαστολὴ Ἰουδαίου τε καὶ Ἕλληνος ὁ γὰρ αὐτὸς Κύριος πάντων πλουτῶν εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἐπικαλουμένους αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: ou gar estin diastolē Ioudaiou te kai Hellēnos ho gar autos Kyrios pantōn ploutōn eis pantas tous epikaloumenous auton
verses.literal: For there is no difference between Jew and Greek The same Lord is Lord of all and gives richly to all who call on Him
verses.literalPt: Porquanto não há diferença entre judeu e grego; porque um mesmo é o Senhor de todos, rico para com todos os que o invocam.

verses.original: Πᾶς γὰρ ὃς ἂν ἐπικαλέσηται τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου σωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Pas gar hos an epikalesētai to onoma Kyriou sōthēsetai
verses.literal: for Everyone who . . . . . . calls on the name of the Lord will be saved
verses.literalPt: Porque todo aquele que invocar o nome do SENHOR será salvo.

verses.original: Πῶς οὖν ἐπικαλέσωνται εἰς ὃν οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν πῶς δὲ πιστεύσωσιν οὗ οὐκ ἤκουσαν πῶς δὲ ἀκούσωσιν χωρὶς κηρύσσοντος
verses.transliteration: Pōs oun epikalesōntai eis hon ouk episteusan pōs de pisteusōsin hou ouk ēkousan pōs de akousōsin chōris kēryssontos
verses.literal: How then can they call on the One in whom they have not believed And how can they believe in the One of whom they have not heard And how can they hear without someone to preach
verses.literalPt: Como, pois, invocarão aquele em quem não creram? e como crerão naquele de quem não ouviram? e como ouvirão, se não há quem pregue?

verses.original: πῶς δὲ κηρύξωσιν ἐὰν μὴ ἀποσταλῶσιν καθὼς γέγραπται Ὡς ὡραῖοι οἱ πόδες τῶν εὐαγγελιζομένων τὰ ἀγαθά
verses.transliteration: pōs de kēryxōsin ean mē apostalōsin kathōs gegraptai Hōs hōraioi hoi podes tōn euangelizomenōn ta agatha
verses.literal: And how can they preach unless . . . they are sent As it is written How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E como pregarão, se não forem enviados? como está escrito: Quão formosos os pés dos que anunciam o evangelho de paz; dos que trazem alegres novas de boas coisas.

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ οὐ πάντες ὑπήκουσαν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ Ἠσαΐας γὰρ λέγει Κύριε τίς ἐπίστευσεν τῇ ἀκοῇ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: All’ ou pantes hypēkousan tō euangeliō Ēsaias gar legei Kyrie tis episteusen tē akoē hēmōn
verses.literal: But not all of them welcomed the good news For Isaiah says Lord who has believed our message
verses.literalPt: Mas nem todos têm obedecido ao evangelho; pois Isaías diz: SENHOR, quem creu na nossa pregação?

verses.original: ἄρα ἡ πίστις ἐξ ἀκοῆς ἡ δὲ ἀκοὴ διὰ ῥήματος Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: ara hē pistis ex akoēs hē de akoē dia rhēmatos Christou
verses.literal: Consequently faith comes by hearing and hearing by the word of Christ
verses.literalPt: De sorte que a fé é pelo ouvir, e o ouvir pela palavra de Deus.

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ λέγω μὴ οὐκ ἤκουσαν μενοῦνγε Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἐξῆλθεν ὁ φθόγγος αὐτῶν καὶ εἰς τὰ πέρατα τῆς οἰκουμένης τὰ ῥήματα αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Alla legō mē ouk ēkousan menounge Eis pasan tēn gēn exēlthen ho phthongos autōn kai eis ta perata tēs oikoumenēs ta rhēmata autōn
verses.literal: But I ask did they not hear . . . Indeed they did Their voice has gone out into all the earth their words to the ends of the world
verses.literalPt: Mas digo: Porventura não ouviram? Sim, por certo, pois Por toda a terra saiu a voz deles, E as suas palavras até aos confins do mundo.

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ λέγω μὴ Ἰσραὴλ οὐκ ἔγνω πρῶτος Μωϋσῆς λέγει Ἐγὼ παραζηλώσω ὑμᾶς ἐπ’ οὐκ ἔθνει ἐπ’ ἔθνει ἀσυνέτῳ παροργιῶ ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Alla legō mē Israēl ouk egnō prōtos Mōusēs legei Egō parazēlōsō hymas ep’ ouk ethnei ep’ ethnei asynetō parorgiō hymas
verses.literal: I ask instead did Israel not . . . understand First Moses says I will make you jealous . . . by those who are not a nation I will make you angry . . . by a nation without understanding
verses.literalPt: Mas digo: Porventura Israel não o soube? Primeiramente diz Moisés: Eu vos porei em ciúmes com aqueles que não são povo, Com gente insensata vos provocarei à ira.

verses.original: Ἠσαΐας δὲ ἀποτολμᾷ καὶ λέγει Εὑρέθην ἐν τοῖς ἐμὲ μὴ ζητοῦσιν ἐμφανὴς ἐγενόμην τοῖς ἐμὲ μὴ ἐπερωτῶσιν
verses.transliteration: Ēsaias de apotolma kai legei Heurethēn en tois eme mē zētousin emphanēs egenomēn tois eme mē eperōtōsin
verses.literal: And Isaiah boldly says I was found by those who did not seek Me I revealed Myself to those who did not ask for Me
verses.literalPt: E Isaías ousadamente diz: Fui achado pelos que não me buscavam, Fui manifestado aos que por mim não perguntavam.

verses.original: Πρὸς δὲ τὸν Ἰσραὴλ λέγει Ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἐξεπέτασα τὰς χεῖράς μου πρὸς λαὸν ἀπειθοῦντα καὶ ἀντιλέγοντα
verses.transliteration: Pros de ton Israēl legei Holēn tēn hēmeran exepetasa tas cheiras mou pros laon apeithounta kai antilegonta
verses.literal: But as for Israel he says All day long I have held out My hands to a disobedient and obstinate people
verses.literalPt: Mas para Israel diz: Todo o dia estendi as minhas mãos a um povo rebelde e contradizente.
